title: Lake nyos co2 vent.jpg
author: Photographer: Bill Evans, USGS
description: Artificial carbon dioxide vent in Lake Nyos, Cameroon. 2006. In 1986, Lake Nyos, in the volcanic region of Cameroon, released a cloud of CO2 into the atmosphere, killing 1,700 people and 3,500 livestock in nearby towns and villages.
